grammar: # Each row is a grammar and its tree, member order included: see test/AGENTS.md.
# The empty grammar, and one of comments alone, hold no rules.
# A rule, its name and its alternatives, each a list of elements.
# An incremental rule is an entry of its own, after the one it extends.
# The empty alternative, first, last and alone.
# Literals: a quoted string matches without regard to case, %s exactly.
# A quoted string has no escapes: a backslash is itself.
# Numeric values: a character, a range, and a concatenation, an exact literal, in each base.
# The platform integer parse reads the longest prefix of digits valid in the base.
# A surrogate pair in a concatenation is the one character it encodes.
# Prose, its angle brackets taken off; a removal is named <all>.
# A group, an option, and their nesting.
# A repetition prefix is the element's last member, as written.
# An option is the repetition from 0 to 1, the innermost before a prefix.
# A value annotation is a comment, and is not kept.
